scripts.start: concurrently -k -n api,front -c blue,green "dotnet watch run --project apps/api --launch-profile https" "npm start --prefix apps/frontend"
scripts.start:withmobile: concurrently -k -n api,front,android -c blue,green,magenta "dotnet watch run --project apps/api --launch-profile https" "npm start --prefix apps/frontend" "npm run android:live"
scripts.test: npm run test:api && npm run test:front
scripts.android:live: cd apps/mobile-android && npx cap run android --live-reload --host localhost --port 4200 --forwardPorts 4200:4200
